name: The Tasks of Messengers and Guardians
source:
Two years ago, Adrian Cerrieve was cursed. No one – not even his family – knows he's a dead man walking. No soul knows that his survival is tied to the town itself. 

But when his former saboteurs find him again, he’ll have to find a way to either fight them or escape.

[From [url=https://treladon.itch.io/tomag]Itch.io[/url]]
